title: 1945 Prairie's corner block rises under its own taller roof
items: In 1904, the Armour/Corwith house at 20th Street and Prairie now carries its corner block's mansard about a storey above the rest of its roof, as the Tribune's 1928 photograph shows. The taller roof turns the cut corner with it, and its three dormers stand high in it. 1945 Prairie now matches its photograph
